name: world_time_convert
description: Convert an ISO-8601 timestamp between two timezones or cities with daylight saving time calculations and spring-forward gap handling.

from_timezone.description: Source timezone identifier, city, or common alias (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'nyc', 'london', 'tokyo').

to_timezone.description: Target timezone identifier, city, or common alias (e.g., 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo', 'sf').

fold.description: Disambiguation for fall-back transition times: 0 for standard/earlier, 1 for daylight/later.

name: world_time_math
description: Perform precise calendar arithmetic by adding or subtracting days, hours, minutes, and seconds relative to an ISO timestamp.

name: world_time_business_days
description: Calculate total business days (Monday-Friday) and weekend days elapsed between two dates.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier or city alias.

name: world_time_find_overlap
description: Find mutual business-hour meeting windows or minimal-fatigue compromise slots across 2 or more global timezones.

zones.description: Comma-separated list of IANA zones, cities, or aliases (e.g. 'sf,london,tokyo').

date.description: Date to evaluate in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to current UTC date).

name: world_time_cron_next
description: Calculate upcoming execution timestamps for a standard 5-part cron expression evaluated in a specific timezone.

expression.description: 5-part cron syntax string (e.g., '0 9 * * 1' for every Monday at 9 AM).

timezone.description: IANA timezone or city alias where the cron schedule runs.

count.description: Total consecutive future occurrences to compute.
